description:
Chris Williamson has become one of the most followed podcasters in Europe. From a bullied and unpopular schoolboy to famous party boy appearing on some of the biggest reality shows, Chris Williamson was living the life most men in their twenties dream about, but he was deeply unsatisfied.

51:10 Dating apps

01:32:42 Masturbation
